newsitem.title: USA: Ion Laser receives patent and FDA approval.
newsitem.headline: Ion Laser receives patent and FDA approval.

text.p: Ion Laser Technology Inc said Wednesday that it has been granted a U.S. patent for its proprietary laser tooth whitening process.

The patent, said the company, includes protection for the use of argon and carbon dioxide lasers in conjunction with chemical whitening agents to whiten teeth, as well as the whitening agents themselves.
It is the seventh patent it has been granted, said the company.

In other news, the company said that it has received approval by the US Food and Drug Administration to market a new, high-power, Argon, dental composite curing and whitening device. The device incorporates a new, patent-pending Argon, Actinic Ray discharge tube, the "Argo HP."
